_comment: The war for your own crown at your death (systems/crownSuccession.js). When the player rules a realm and the seat passes (death, abdication, the return from an interregnum), claimants weigh their strength against the heir's standing; one who rises is backed by the realm's named lords (Kingship vassals) and makes war as a succession revolt (Kingship revolt machinery: hosts, field battles, sieges, momentum, parley). Lost, the realm splits: the claimant takes his lords' seats as a kingdom of his own (a rival with a claim on the crown). The capital lost, the crown itself goes. Years are heirSettings.daysPerYear days.

config._rise: A claimant rises with chance (strength - heir standing + riseBase) / riseDivisor, at most riseMax. Only claimants of strength 1+ are weighed.
config._minLordShare: A risen claimant needs lords holding this share of the realm's lord power behind him to make war; with fewer he finds no swords and stands down.

brother._: The late ruler's other grown children (16+), and his own siblings (uncles: x uncleMult). Sons and daughters weigh differently. Excluded: in holy orders, wed abroad, exiled, unfit.

cadet._: A cadet branch's head: (50 - loyalty) x perLoyaltyBelow50 + base, +estranged; none at loyaltyAbove or more.

spouseKin._: The late ruler's royal spouse's kin, of another realm: they want the regency of a child heir (none if the spouse is regent), and press harder if their realm is hostile.

pretender._: The realm's old royal line, where the crown was taken rather than founded: base, less decayPerYear for each year the House has held it; a pension quiets it (x quietMult), a cloister ends it for cloister years, a marriage into it (the ruler's or heir's royal spouse of this realm) joins the lines.

lean._: A lord backs the claimant when his lean is above 0: his opinion of the crown x opinionWeight, the claimant's edge over the heir x edgeWeight, (ambition - 5.5) x ambitionPer, an oath to the heir (honor x oathPerHonor), kin of the claimant, kin of the crown, a council seat, cowed, and his own temper (a fixed hash, +-noise).

war._: Starting momentum (crown's share of support - 0.5) x startMomentum. A foreign realm behind the claimant (the spouse's kin; a realm hostile to yours behind the old line) sends foreignShare of its army (at most foreignMax) to the rebels.

interregnum._: A wait of usurpYears or more with a claimant of usurpMinStrength who rises: he took the crown while the House waited.
